features.title: NPC Mentor Master Data
features.description: New NPC character system with name, location, bio, and images. NPCs serve as mentors for hobbies.

features.title: Hobby Master Data
features.description: Track hobbies with associated NPC mentors, max levels, and images.

features.title: Time Period Master Data
features.description: Manage time periods (morning, afternoon, night, etc.) with images and descriptions.

features.title: Enhanced Data Display
features.description: Seeds now show growth time, sell price, hobby, and hobby level. All items display related hobby and time information.

features.title: Multiple Time Selection
features.description: Insects, Fish, and Birds now support multiple time periods (like weather).

features.title: Shadow Size for Fish
features.description: Fish now have shadow size property (S/M/L/Golden/Blue) for better categorization.

features.title: Searchable Inputs
features.description: NPC location and Hobby NPC inputs are now searchable for better UX.

features.title: Star Rating Display
features.description: Star ratings now use ★ symbol instead of 's' for clearer visual representation.

features.title: Update default / reset game data json
features.description: The default game data json has been updated to include the new fields, categories and new 85 Fish item. You can download the latest json data from the Official Folder in GDrive Community.

features.title: Rating Based on 1-Star Price
features.description: S/A/B/C/D rating now calculated from 1-star price instead of max price

features.title: Locations for Ingredients
features.description: Ingredients now support multiple locations just like other categories

features.title: Weather Master Data
features.description: New Weather category for managing weather conditions with image support

features.title: Weather in Birds, Fish & Insects
features.description: Birds, Fish, and Insects now support multiple weather conditions

features.title: Alphabetical Sorting in Selects
features.description: All dropdown options now automatically sorted alphabetically

features.title: Birds Data Category
features.description: New category for managing bird data with same features as fish

features.title: Data Merge Preview
features.description: Preview changes before applying with detailed diff and checkbox selection

features.title: Cloudinary Image Upload
features.description: Upload images with crop functionality or paste URL manually

features.title: Rating System (S-D)
features.description: Foods, insects, and fish now have quality ratings

features.title: Sell Calculator
features.description: Calculate total sell price with quantity and star ratings

features.title: SEO Optimization
features.description: Enhanced search engine visibility and meta tags

features.title: Data Source Link
features.description: Quick access to latest .json updates in dashboard
